title: Anti-uncraftable
body:
# New Crafting Recipes

1. Coral Block / Dead Coral Block
1. Calcite

1. Sponge / Wet Sponge
1. Tuff
# New Mob Drops:

Drowned that spawn in Ocean biomes and are swimming now have a chance to drop a Sniffer Egg.

Base drop rate: 4%

Looting increases the chance by 1% per level.

A Guardian killed by a Creeper or Charged Creeper will drop the "otherside" Music Disc.

A Guardian killed by a player will drop a Disc Fragment 5.

Guardians now always drop an Echo Shard upon death.

A Zombified Piglin killed by a Creeper or Charged Creeper will drop the "Pigstep" Music Disc.
# New Mechanics and Archaeology Loot Tables:

### Sniffer Digging Mechanics:

Sniffers now dig up Suspicious Sand / Suspicious Gravel with associated loot tables (50% chance to drop).

When a Sniffer digs in a Desert Temple (structure), it yields Suspicious Sand with the Desert Temple loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in Desert (biome), it yields Suspicious Sand with the Desert Well loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in Jungle, Forest, Birch Forest, Swamp, Dark Forest, Taiga, or Giant Tree Taiga (biomes):

25% chance for Suspicious Gravel with the Trail Ruins (Common) loot table.

25% chance for Suspicious Gravel with the Trail Ruins (Rare) loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in Frozen Ocean and Cold Ocean (biomes), it yields Suspicious Gravel with the Cold Ocean Ruin loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in Lukewarm Ocean and Warm Ocean (biomes), it yields Suspicious Gravel with the Warm Ocean Ruin loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in a Lush Caves (biome), it yields Suspicious Gravel with the Lush Caves loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in a Deep Dark (biome), it yields Suspicious Gravel with the Deep Dark loot table.

When a Sniffer digs in the Nether (dimension), it yields Suspicious Gravel with the Nether loot table.
